metadata.name: property
metadata.description: Letting agents, rental income distribution, and property governance for the realXmarket protocol

accounts.name: program

accounts.name: agent_token

accounts.name: notice

accounts.name: rent_payer

accounts.name: holding
docs: The voter's share ledger, owned by the marketplace; the unlock CPI
releases the vote's shares from it.

accounts.name: payer
docs: Whoever fronts the vote record's rent: the sponsor on the default
path, or any willing wallet, so one protocol key can never decide the
election by withholding its signature. The record remembers who to
refund.

accounts.name: voter_role
docs: The caller's RealEstateInvestor role, owned by the roles program.

accounts.name: holding
docs: The voter's share ledger, owned by the marketplace; the vote locks
part of it through the CPI.

accounts.name: vote_record
docs: This round's vote record; revoting reuses it.

accounts.name: candidacy
docs: The candidacy voted for.

accounts.name: previous_candidacy
docs: The candidacy a revote moves power away from; required only when the
previous vote backed a different candidate.

types.name: AccessPermission
docs: Compliance status for a (user, role) assignment, set by an admin after
off-chain KYC/AML. Only the marketplace's investor-fund calls (listing,
buying, offers, share transfers, lawyer case work) require this flag on
top of the role; every other instruction checks role possession alone.
Later it'll be driven by a SAS attestation instead of a manual toggle.
Do not reorder the variants: the serialized `RoleAccount.permission`
stores the variant index, so a reorder flips every stored status.

types.name: AgentCandidacy
docs: One agent standing in one election round; carries their own tally.

fields.name: round
docs: The election round the candidacy belongs to.

fields.name: vote_power
docs: Share-weighted votes cast for this candidate.

fields.name: rent_payer
docs: The wallet that fronted the account's rent; refunded at close.

types.name: AgentElection
docs: The running agent election. Any eligible agent may stand; the first
candidacy opens the voting window and shareholders vote among the
candidates. A round that elects nobody simply reopens: rounds repeat
until an agent is engaged. One round at a time per property.

fields.name: expiry
docs: When voting closes; zero while no round is running.

fields.name: candidate_count
docs: Candidates standing in the current round.

fields.name: round
docs: Round number, monotonic per property. Candidacies and vote records
are keyed by it, so nothing stale can count toward a later round.

fields.name: quorum_bps
docs: Quorum at the moment the round opened, so a config change can't move
the goalposts mid-vote.

fields.name: assigned_count
docs: Properties currently assigned to the agent in this location. Leaving
the location requires zero.

fields.name: deposit
docs: The deposit locked when this location was registered, recorded so a
later config change can't reprice the refund.

types.name: AgentVote
docs: One investor's vote in one agent election round. The voting shares stay
locked in the marketplace ShareHolding until the record is closed again
by `unlock_agent_votes`.

fields.name: round
docs: The election round the vote belongs to.

fields.name: choice
docs: The candidate voted for.

fields.name: power
docs: The shares this vote locked and counts for.

fields.name: rent_payer
docs: The wallet that fronted the record's rent; refunded at close.

fields.name: authority
docs: Authority allowed to update parameters.

fields.name: pending_authority
docs: Proposed replacement authority; takes over via `accept_authority`.
Two-step so a typo'd address can't brick parameter management.

fields.name: xcav_mint
docs: The XCAV mint agent deposits are paid in.

fields.name: treasury
docs: Owner of the shared protocol treasury (a multisig on mainnet).
Slashes are paid to this key's token accounts; the program never
holds them.

fields.name: rent_collector
docs: The sponsor wallet that fronts account rent for holders. Sponsored
closes send their lamports here, not to the holder.

fields.name: agent_deposit
docs: XCAV an agent locks per location they register in.

fields.name: agent_voting_time
docs: Seconds an agent election stays open once the first candidacy claims.

fields.name: min_voting_quorum_bps
docs: Share of a property's supply that must vote for an agent election to
be valid, in basis points.

fields.name: agent_notice_period
docs: Seconds between an agent's resignation notice and the seat opening.

types.name: ConfigParams
docs: Protocol parameters for the property program.

types.name: LettingAgent
docs: A letting agent's registry entry, one per wallet. Agents work one region
and any number of its locations up to the cap; each location holds its
own deposit and counts the properties assigned there.

fields.name: region_id
docs: The one region this agent covers.

fields.name: rent_payer
docs: Who funded the account's rent and gets it back at close.

types.name: Location
docs: A registered postcode within a region. Existence is the point: the
marketplace requires a listing's location PDA to exist for its region.

fields.name: postcode
docs: The postcode, as seeded (uppercase ASCII, no spaces).

fields.name: deposit
docs: The XCAV locked when the location was registered. Released on removal,
even if the configured deposit has changed since.

types.name: PropertyAsset
docs: A fractionalized property. Created when it is listed and kept for the
asset's whole life; the Core asset and share mint are attached by
`init_property_assets`.

fields.name: core_asset
docs: The Metaplex Core asset held in the property vault. Default until the
assets are initialized.

fields.name: share_mint
docs: The Token-2022 share mint. Default until the assets are initialized.

fields.name: location
docs: The registered location (postcode) the property sits in.

fields.name: holder_count
docs: Wallets currently holding shares; teardown completes when it reaches
zero again.

types.name: PropertyLetting
docs: A property's letting seat: who manages it and the election that fills the
seat. Created by the first candidacy and kept for the property's life.

fields.name: agent
docs: The assigned agent; default while the seat is vacant.

fields.name: rent_payer
docs: The wallet that fronted the account's rent.

types.name: ResignationNotice
docs: An assigned agent's notice that they are stepping down. The seat opens
once the notice period has run, via the `finalize_resignation` crank.

fields.name: agent
docs: The resigning agent, recorded so the crank can release their
assignment even if the seat's state moves on.

fields.name: due_ts
docs: When the resignation takes effect.

fields.name: rent_payer
docs: The wallet that fronted the account's rent; refunded at close.

types.name: Role
docs: All roles recognised across the realXmarket protocol.
A role is app-level authorization, separate from KYC/compliance. Compliance
lives in [`AccessPermission`], and will eventually be driven by SAS
attestations rather than a manually set flag.
Do not reorder the variants: the serialized `RoleAccount.role` stores the
variant index, so a reorder reinterprets every existing assignment.

types.name: RoleAccount
docs: One (user, role) assignment together with its compliance status.

fields.name: rent_payer
docs: Who paid the account's rent (the assigning admin); every teardown
refunds them, whoever triggers it.

types.name: ShareHolding
docs: The canonical share ledger for one holder of one property. The Token-2022
accounts mirror this; they never lead it.

fields.name: locked_amount
docs: Shares locked by votes; blocked from transfer until unlocked.

constants.name: CPI_AUTH_SEED
docs: Signer PDA for CPIs into the marketplace; carries no account data.
